title: Queen Suite 2BR/2BA in Upscale 4-Star Hotel
description:
Upscale hotel condominium on Music Row. Walking distance to downtown Nashville. Many amenities including: Valet Parking ($52/day), 24 hour Concierge Desk, Free Shuttle Downtown every 30 mins, Outdoor Pool, Exercise Room,  Lounge, Downtown View, Bluetooth Record Player and Guitars in the unit, Ping Pong, and more!

The space
This is a 2 bed 2 bath 838 sqft unit on the 7th floor of the Motif on Music Row building. Location is 50 Music Sq W, Nashville, TN

Guest access
Your room key will be available at the front desk upon arival. Guests have full access to all amenities within the building but valet parking costs extra. Less expensive garage available across the street.
